dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give me the rundown about Snezhnaya, if you would...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Adventurers regard Snezhnaya as a vast territory, a great place to show off one's skills...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: But be cautious. The bitter cold on the frozen plains and the disasters caused by the Shadow Realm demand extra attention to safety while exploring.
